prompt: Design a thread-safe Singleton pattern implementation in C# utilizing double-check locking and lazy initialization.

criterion_scores.name: Thread Safety (0-5)
criterion_scores.justification: The implementation correctly uses volatile keyword, double-check locking, and a static readonly lock object, ensuring thread-safe initialization under concurrent access.

criterion_scores.name: Lazy Initialization (0-5)
criterion_scores.justification: The singleton instance is created only when first accessed via the Instance property, preventing early initialization and ensuring lazy behavior.
